title: HP Sold Twice as Much Ink as Printers #shorts
summary: HP fiscal 2025: $5.8B of printers, $10.9B of ink and toner.
sources: HP Inc. fiscal 2025 results (year ended Oct 31, 2025), Exhibit 99.1: total net revenue $55,295M; Personal Systems revenue $38,532M, earnings from operations $2,054M (5.3%); Printing revenue $16,702M, earnings from operations $3,118M (18.7%); Supplies $10,916M (2024: $11,295M); Commercial Printing $4,633M; Consumer Printing $1,153M: https://www.hp.com/us-en/newsroom/press-releases/2025/hp-inc-reports-fiscal-2025-full-year-and-fourth-quarter-results.html

HP Inc. fiscal 2025 Form 10-K, Item 1A: "While our big tank printers typically have a higher initial margin than our traditional in cartridge printers, they do not result in follow-on sales of high margin traditional ink cartridges and, as a result, may have lower overall device lifetime profitability." Commercial and Consumer Printing exclude supplies: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/47217/000004721725000071/hpq-20251031.htm
Our calculations: printer hardware $4,633M + $1,153M = $5,786M; supplies / printing revenue = 65%; supplies change -3.4%.

scenes.narration: HP sold {$5.8 billion|five point eight billion} worth of printers last year.
Ink and toner: {$10.9 billion.|ten point nine billion.}
Almost twice as much as the printers themselves.
